title: Imani Da Ke Bayan Al'arshi
intro: Wasu rayuka ba a gwada su da wuta ko ambaliyar ruwa ba, sai dai ta hanyar matsin lamba a hankali na zama a cikin fadar azzalumi. Wannan mutum yana tsaye kusa da wani shugaba wanda ya yi iƙirarin allahntaka a kan mutanensa, amma a ɓoye ya manne da imani da Allah Ɗaya na Gaskiya. Lokacin da aka gano ibadarsu, wahala ta zo - amma haka aka yi alƙawarin allahntaka. Za ku iya tunanin wanene wannan?
clues: Na zauna a ƙarƙashin rufin babban mai mulki mafi ƙarfi a ƙasarmu, a wani matsayi da mutane da yawa ba za su iya tunaninsa ba.
Matata ta tsaya a gaban mutane ta bayyana kanta a matsayin allah - amma zuciyata ta kasance ta Ubangiji ɗaya ta gaskiya.
Na yi addu'o'i a ɓoye, ina jin tsoron hukuncin da zai zo wa duk wanda ya ƙi mijina.
Lokacin da aka fallasa imanina, an kama ni aka azabtar da ni - duk da haka harshena bai taɓa furta kalma ta rashin imani ba.
Na faɗa wa Ubangijina zuciyata, ina neman gida a Aljanna, nesa da duk wani laifi.
Ni ce Asiya bint Muzahim — matar Fir'auna wadda ta yi adawa da Musa da Haruna.

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Asiya Bint Muzahim (Matar Fir'auna)
Hauwa'u (Hauwa'u), mace ta farko
Saratu, matar Ibrahim ta farko
Hajara, mahaifiyar Isma'il
Mahaifiyar Maryam (matar Imran)

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Jure azaba saboda ƙin yin watsi da imani
Rayuwa a cikin cikin babban kifi
Gina babban jirgi domin gujewa ambaliyar ruwa
Ana jefa shi cikin wuta mai ƙuna
Shaidar rabuwar babban teku
trial.answer: Jure azaba saboda ƙin yin watsi da imani

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: An gina musu gida a Aljanna
Sanda wadda ta rikide ta zama maciji
Jirgin ruwa mai ɗauke da nau'i-nau'i na kowace halitta
Ɗan maraƙin zinare da al'umma ke bautawa
Majajjawa da ake amfani da ita don kayar da babban jarumi
location.answer: An gina musu gida a Aljanna

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An girmama shi da zama a Aljanna tare da salihai
An nutsar da su a ƙarƙashin raƙuman ruwa tare da rundunarsu
An ƙone shi da wuta amma an cece shi ta hanyar taimakon Allah
Wani babban halitta ya haɗiye shi sannan aka jefa shi a bakin teku
Ya zama mutum mafi arziki a zamaninsu
outcome.answer: An girmama shi da zama a Aljanna tare da salihai

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
